Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 93 (NTT RagingWire Hillsboro, row 2, further attempt): a single, uncorroborated 0.9 confidence reverse geocode candidate, 25300 Evergreen Rd, Hillsboro, OR 97124, recorded but not applied absent a second source, its sibling row could not be geocoded for cross row comparison. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This facility is attributed in the registry to NTT, part of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation, one of the largest telecommunications and IT services groups in the world, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. NTT operates a global data center business, NTT Global Data Centers, under NTT DATA, Inc. The operators own about us page, fetched this session, states NTT DATA is a top 10 global IT services provider with about 30 billion dollars in annual revenue, operations across 33 countries, and about 3 billion dollars in annual research and development investment, headquartered at the Toyosu Center Building, 3-3-3 Toyosu, Koto-ku, Tokyo 135-6033, Japan, though these figures describe the wider NTT DATA organization rather than the data center division specifically, and no data center division formation or acquisition date was found on the pages fetched this session. A previously confirmed, specific data center acquisition remains NTT Communications purchase of an 86.7 percent stake in e-shelter, described as Germany top data center operator, completed around June 23, 2015, though that acquisition is not directly connected to this United States facility. This session reached the operators own services.global.ntt data center locations pages directly and successfully. An earlier sessions attempts to reach the ragingwire.com domain had failed and found no corresponding Wikipedia article, a negative finding this session did not need to repeat. No dedicated operator facility page or Oregon or Hillsboro area overview page was found this session, a guessed overview URL returned 404. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned a single, high confidence candidate, 25300 Evergreen Rd, Hillsboro, OR 97124, at 0.9 confidence and a tight 0.012 distance. However, this rows sibling entry sharing the same generic registry name was throttled on repeated attempts and never returned a comparable result to check for cross row consistency, and no operator page or aggregator listing was found to independently confirm this specific street. Consistent with this projects standard that a geocoding services own confidence score is not itself corroboration, this session records the candidate but does not apply it as this rows address.
